title: Compliance Standard — Contract Expiration Notices on Residential Natural Gas Supply
content:
**Standard 1.** Every Residential Natural Gas Supply agreement with a term receives two expiration notices: an initial renewal notice and a final options notice. Gas renewal notices are issued only on an active agreement with a term, as the agreement's status in the company's records shows.

**Standard 2 — initial renewal notice.** The initial renewal notice is compliant when its notice date falls no earlier than 60 and no later than 45 calendar days before the contract end date.

**Standard 3 — final options notice.** The final options notice is compliant when its notice date falls no later than 30 calendar days before the contract end date and after the initial notice.

**Standard 4 — content (retired clause).** The former clause read: each notice states the plan offered for renewal, the renewal rate and the month-to-month rate for the first cycle after expiry, and when the two notices differ the final options notice governs. **This clause is no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

**Standard 5 — delivery.** Notices are delivered by email only to customers who enrolled through the web channel, and by mail otherwise.

The figures 60, 45 and 30 are the same on every plan.

### Compliance worked through (hypothetical contract end date 30 September)

| Notice | Notice date | Calendar days before 30 September | Compliant |
|---|---|---|---|
| Initial renewal notice | 31 July | 61 | No (earlier than 60) |
| Initial renewal notice | 1 August | 60 | Yes |
| Initial renewal notice | 16 August | 45 | Yes |
| Initial renewal notice | 17 August | 44 | No (later than 45) |
| Final options notice (initial dated 5 August) | 31 August | 30 | Yes |
| Final options notice (initial dated 5 August) | 1 September | 29 | No (later than 30) |
| Final options notice (initial dated 5 August) | 5 August | 56 | No (not after the initial notice) |

### Delivery

| Enrollment channel of the agreement | Notice delivery |
|---|---|
| web | email |
| phone or mail | mail |

superseded_clauses: Each notice states the plan offered for renewal, the renewal rate and the month-to-month rate for the first cycle after expiry; when the two notices differ, the final_options_notice governs.
